title: Selling Plans Schedule — Sales Volume Bonus on Discount Dispute Credits
content:
A discount dispute credit on **Selling Plans** carries a volume bonus that turns on the seller's recent sales volume, measured as fee basis.

**Schedule clause.** The volume bonus of a discount dispute credit is the high volume bonus when the fee basis of the variable final value fee records billed within the volume window is at least the high volume basis, the mid volume bonus when it is at least the mid volume basis but below the high volume basis, and nothing below the mid volume basis.

The volume bonus is added to the discount dispute rate of the credit. Bonuses are added together with that rate first and the total is applied once to the variable final value fee billed on the disputed record; no bonus acts on another.

## Schedule

| Fee basis of the variable final value fee records billed within the volume window | Volume bonus added to the discount dispute rate |
|---|---|
| USD 20000.00 or more (the high volume basis) | 3 percentage points |
| USD 8000.00 or more but below USD 20000.00 (the mid volume basis up to the high) | 2 percentage points |
| Below USD 8000.00 | None |

The fee basis counted is that shown on each variable final value fee record (item subtotal plus shipping, tax excluded), added together over the records billed within the volume window.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical totals)

- USD 20000.00 → 3 points; USD 19999.99 → 2 points.
- USD 8000.00 → 2 points; USD 7999.99 → no volume bonus.

**Addition, not compounding (hypothetical).** A rate of 12% with a volume bonus of 2 points is a rate of 14%, applied once: on a variable fee of USD 50.00 that is USD 7.00.
